I didn't think to much into it and the tingle got stronger. So I washed my face with a gentle cleanser and my mouth area along with my eye lids were beat red, swollen and itching. Will not ever use a coola product.

I have spent hundreds of dollars on sunscreens trying to find one that works for my face that isn't immediately discontinued after finding (looking at you, Hang Ten+COOLA Classic Face). With that in mind, I tried this serum, and ended up getting photocontact dermatitis after being outside on a hot, sunny day. Resulting in a very hot, flush face, red bumps, which developed into white pus-filled acne-like bumps, and took a week for my face to go back to normal. This isn't the only COOLA sunscreen product that caused this issue on my face, and only my face. Other than the Avobenzone which is linked to this issue, I haven't been able to identify the reason why some sunscreens with it cause this issue and some do not. So, because this product has caused me pain, both physically and mentally, heck I'll throw emotionally in there too as my feelings were hurt, I cannot recommend it to others like myself. It is now thrown into the basket full of sunscreens condemned for body use only.

This has quickly become a must have product for me! I always have issues with sunscreens looking cakey under makeup, not being hydrating enough, or looking greasy throughout the day. I'm also always in a rush in the morning, so I really only want to wait a minute or two for my skincare to sink in before putting on my makeup. I was on the hunt for a suncreen with a serum consistency that wore well under makeup on my dry skin. This is just that and MORE! The first time I used it, I was blown away by how it made my skin look throughout the day. It was like I had a smoothing filter on. My makeup actually looks better with this on underneath! That is something no other suncreen has done for me. It's also very plumping and calming for my tired morning skin. On top of all of that, I actually did notice that my skin looked more relaxed than usual at the end of my work day in tech. I swear staring at a screen all day is giving me fine lines, so I was excited to see the digital de-stress technology, but I definitely did not expect to see immediate benefits. I assumed it would be more of an overtime thing. That was a fantastic surprise that really pushed this product over the top for me!

Light as air yet deeply quenching, the COOLA Refreshing Water Plumping Gel Serum is a true masterpiece in hydration. With its weightless, water-gel texture, this serum glides onto the skin effortlessly, delivering an instant burst of cooling moisture that feels like a fresh splash of revitalization.At the heart of this luxurious formula lies hyaluronic acid, the ultimate skin-plumper, working its magic to replenish moisture levels and smooth fine lines. avis.titre: One of the best water serums!
avis.texte: Water serums are huge right now, and I've tried my fair share lately, so I was excited to try out Coolas take on it, with the additions of SPF as well. The added hyaluronic acid, organic aloe and organic coconut water create an instant cooling and refreshing sensation when applying. The product applies easily and absorbs without leaving the skin sticky. The SPF 30 ensures protection from UVA/UVB rays, while marine-derived alaria esculenta extract stimulates collagen production and delivers moisture to the deepest layers of skin. I love that this serum is more of an "apply as needed", rather than others that require you to keep track of time and apply every few hours.
